contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-radar-fraudulent-merchant-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-radar-fraudulent-merchant-signal-2026.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/radar/fraudulent-merchant`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/radar/fraudulent-merchant describes Stripe automatically assessing new or existing connected accounts; a platform does not request the merchant signal on demand. It is available with Radar Standard and higher, while probability and indicator details require Plus or Pro and are absent for unknown. Stripe sends v2.signals.account_signal.fraudulent_merchant_ready with empty data; the platform fetches the signal by related_object.id, with up to 90 days of retrieval and only the latest listed signal per requested type (new raw lines 9-30 and 44-119). May assigned risk_level and probability to each signal and described result fields in the event (old raw lines 10-20 and 38-40). source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md retains that May contract and needs the November plan, risk level and retrieval qualifications.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/radar/fraudulent-merchant, substantive November changes include signal-versus-detail plan access, revised risk and indicator vocabulary, thin event retrieval, latest-only listing, 90-day retention visibility and sandbox-only signal fixtures (new raw lines 9-46, 85-119 and 131-147). Preserve May's five levels and result-bearing readiness description as dated, alongside November's explicit unknown handling and the stable event name (old raw lines 10-24 and 38-40). The link to Account Fraud Prevention is navigational and result examples do not establish account eligibility or trigger automatic rejection (old raw lines 42-44; new raw lines 149-151). Preserve the reciprocal Radar concept and sibling website and delinquency raw routes in source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md, with those contracts evaluated separately.
